newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares close down on correction.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares close down on correction.

text.p: Shanghai B shares closed down on Wednesday on a technical correction after sharp gains in the past days, brokers said.
The index fell 0.461 points or 0.86 percent to 53.305 points, on volume of 17.4 million shares worth $8.0 million. Of 42 B shares, 40 traded, with 24 down, six flat and 10 up.
Brokers said profit-taking and unwinding selling depressed the market after sharp gains in the past days and the market direction will be decided by the actions of the authorities.

"Rumours that Beijing will reaffirm a ban on domestic investors buying B shares to restrain recent excess speculation in the Shenzhen B share market was also an important factor in dampening the market," one broker said.
"The correction is reasonable after such rapid rises in the past few days but the market trend will depend on Beijing's attitude," another broker said.
Shanghai Dajiang was the biggest loser on speculative selling, down $0.028 or 6.39 percent to $0.410, on volume of 10,000 shares.
Shanghai Friendship & Overseas Chinese followed, down $0.024 or 6.03 percent to $0.344, on volume of 29,100 shares.

Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development traded the most and reversed morning gains on heavy profit-taking despite institutional support, losing $0.026 or 2.37 percent to $1.070, on volume of 2.1 million shares.
Shanghai A share index edged up on cautious buying, but trading was dull, with most investors on the sidelines, brokers said.

The A index rose 13.984 points or 1.38 percent to 1029.576 points, on volume of 464.0 million shares worth 4.5 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip index gained 32.663 points or 1.34 percent to 2468.454 points.
Inner Mongolia Yili was the star, on institutional speculative buying, soaring 2.72 yuan or 12.20 percent to 25.00 yuan, on volume of 1.3 million shares.
